scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres redis minio && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm minio-init
scripts.infra:obs: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile obs up -d otel-lgtm
scripts.infra:tunnel: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile tunnel up -d ngrok
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile obs --profile tunnel down
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml --profile obs --profile tunnel down -v
